name: Waluipedia Bros Attacks

description.value:
Green T steadies Remi's aim, adjusts her position, and calls the timing for a coordinated support-fire shot.

Bros Energy: Each participating character spends 1 from a maximum of 2. Refreshes after a very short rest.

Archive caution: A clearer shot does not make the target lawful or safe.

activation.condition: An ally is available to steady aim and call timing.

description.value:
Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee to vine-height while Toad Lee chops through growth. The verified third attempt opened twenty-five feet of corridor and pushed back a large amount of leaf growth.

Bros Energy: Each participating character spends 1 from a maximum of 2. Refreshes after a very short rest.

Requirements: A strong lifting partner, a clear axe arc, room to advance, and shared rhythm. Do not use a shouted countdown.

activation.condition: A lifting partner and a cutting partner can coordinate safely.
